title: ProvFold 0.1.2: provenance-aware direction-based microbiome evidence synthesis
description:
ProvFold is a Python package for provenance-aware aggregation of qualitative taxon-direction evidence. It validates analyst-declared provenance groups, comparison scope and taxonomic mappings and produces traceable votes, abstentions, estimator comparisons, threshold surfaces and group-omission analyses.

Version 0.1.2 provides the Python API and CLI, source-linked AH and HCC examples, the 18-scenario benchmark with 1,720 replicates and 30,960 configured-cell evaluations, complete support-threshold and estimator-equivalence post-processing, independent validators, and figure-generation scripts. The 18 configurations represent 10 distinct estimators.

The source archive contains the complete software and executable reproduction controls. The reproducibility archive contains the machine-readable analytical materials, deterministic synthetic streams, generated results and validation records. Core execution requires Python 3.11 or later and has no third-party runtime dependencies. Public-resource reconstruction additionally requires openpyxl 3.1.5 and five separately obtained, SHA-256-identified source files. Plotting requires Matplotlib, NumPy and Pillow.

The public-resource arms are analysed separately. Publication or BioProject grouping is an analyst-declared evidence unit, not proof of cohort independence. The software supports traceable recurrence analysis; it does not automatically identify cohorts, infer missing taxonomic lineage, or establish biological validity.

Software: MIT licence. Author-produced reproduction inputs and derived data: CC BY 4.0. Third-party database exports are not redistributed and retain their own rights.

The authors confirm 13 August 2026 as the acquisition date for the five public-resource input files. The source identities remain defined by SHA-256. The AH review provides aggregate full-text exclusion categories; a citation-level exclusion list and individual reasons were not recorded.
